login.title: Sign in
login.totpHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
enrol.intro: Two-factor authentication is required. Scan this with your authenticator app.
enrol.manualHint: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually instead:
enrol.code: Enter the code your app shows
enrol.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
enrol.qrFailed: The QR code could not be drawn. Use the key below instead.
recovery.warning: These codes are shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
recovery.intro: Save these somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator.
enrol.done: Two-factor authentication is on. Sign in again to finish.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address you sign in with. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires shortly.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Pick a password you do not use anywhere else.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.deadLinkBody: The link is incomplete, already used, or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reset.doneBody: You have been signed out everywhere else. Sign in again with your new password.
appError.title: This page could not be loaded
appError.description: The app may have been updated since you opened this tab. Reloading usually fixes it.

customers.list.loadFailed: The customer list could not be loaded.
customers.list.emptyPage: There are no customers on this page.
customers.create.title: New customer
customers.create.intro: The customer starts with an empty MYR wallet and stays suspended until its balance is above zero.
customers.form.saveFailed: The customer could not be saved.
customers.form.companyNameTooLong: The company name can be at most 255 characters.
customers.form.emailTooLong: The email address can be at most 320 characters.
customers.form.contactNameTooLong: The contact name can be at most 255 characters.
customers.form.phoneTooLong: The phone number can be at most 32 characters.
customers.detail.loadFailed: The customer could not be loaded.
customers.detail.notFoundBody: No customer has this ID. The link may be mistyped or out of date.
customers.detail.unchanged: Nothing was changed, so nothing was saved.
customers.projects.title: Projects
customers.projects.loadFailed: The projects could not be loaded.
customers.projects.empty: This customer has no projects yet.
customers.projects.emptyPage: There are no projects on this page.
customers.projects.field.name: Project name
customers.projects.createFailed: The project could not be created.
customers.projects.nameTooLong: The project name can be at most 255 characters.
customers.projects.descriptionTooLong: The description can be at most 1000 characters.
integrations.title: Integration API credentials
integrations.loadFailed: The credentials could not be loaded.
integrations.empty: This project has no API credentials yet.
integrations.emptyPage: There are no credentials on this page.
integrations.unknownTitle: We could not confirm whether a new credential was issued.
integrations.create.failed: The API key could not be created.
integrations.create.unknownBody: It was not retried automatically. If it was stored, a new API key appears in the list below, but its secret can never be shown again: revoke that key and create another one.
integrations.rotate.confirmBody: A new version with a new secret is issued after version {{version}}. The secret is shown once. Older versions that are still active stop working when the rotation overlap period ends.
integrations.rotate.failed: The API key could not be rotated.
integrations.rotate.conflictTitle: This API key has already been rotated by someone else.
integrations.rotate.conflictBody: Nothing was changed. The list has been refreshed: check the latest version before rotating again.
integrations.rotate.unknownBody: It was not retried automatically. If the new version was stored, its secret can never be shown again. Check the list below: if a version appeared that you did not get the secret for, rotate again or revoke that version.
integrations.secret.title: New API credential
integrations.secret.warning: This secret is shown only once. After you close this dialog it cannot be viewed again. Copy it and store it safely now.
integrations.secret.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the secret and copy it by hand.
integrations.secret.close: I have saved the secret, close
integrations.revoke.keyTitle: Revoke every version of this API key?
integrations.revoke.versionWarning: Revoking is permanent. This version stops working immediately and can never be made active again.
integrations.revoke.keyWarning: Revoking is permanent. Every active version of this key stops working immediately and can never be made active again.
integrations.revoke.reasonHint: Write only the business reason. Do not include personal data such as names, phone numbers or email addresses. The reason is kept in the audit log.
integrations.revoke.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 255 characters.
wallet.adjustment.title: Manual wallet adjustment
wallet.adjustment.amountHint: Enter the amount without a sign. Credit types add it to the balance; debit types take it away.
wallet.adjustment.amountInvalid: Enter digits only: up to 12 before the decimal point and up to 8 after it, with no sign or exponent.
wallet.adjustment.reasonHint: Write only the business reason. Do not include personal data such as names, phone numbers or email addresses. The reason is kept permanently and can never be changed.
wallet.adjustment.reasonTooLong: The reason can be at most 255 characters.
wallet.adjustment.unknownTitle: We could not confirm whether the adjustment was posted.
wallet.adjustment.unknownBody: It may already be on the ledger. Retry with the same key: if it was posted, the retry will not post it again. The type, amount and reason are now locked. To post something different, close this form and check the balance first.
wallet.adjustment.conflictTitle: This adjustment conflicts with one already posted under the same key.
wallet.adjustment.conflictBody: Nothing was posted. Close this form and check the balance before starting again.
wallet.adjustment.replayed: This adjustment had already been posted earlier. It was not posted again.
wallet.adjustment.replayedNote: The amount and balance below are the ones recorded when it was first posted.
